archetype: 5 (Jewel & Luxury - adapted for Cinematic Mythical RPG)
design_philosophy: A 2.5D immersive RPG blending a 3D environment with 2D pixel art. The UI must feel cinematic, dangerous, and deeply atmospheric, drawing from The Odyssey. The interface acts as a glass overlay on a living, breathing, rainy world.

layout_and_spacing.philosophy: Cinematic and asymmetric. The game canvas is the hero. Avoid center-everything disease. Elements anchor to the edges to frame the action.

components.dialogue_box: fixed bottom-12 left-12 w-[calc(100%-6rem)] md:w-[60%] max-w-3xl p-8 backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/80 border-l-4 border-[#C5A059] shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.8)]
components.hud: absolute top-12 left-12 flex flex-col gap-6 z-50
components.boss_bar: absolute top-12 right-12 w-[60%] max-w-xl z-50 flex flex-col items-end

buttons.primary: bg-transparent border border-[#C5A059] text-[#C5A059] px-8 py-4 uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-sm hover:bg-[#C5A059] hover:text-black transition-all duration-300 shadow-none hover:shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(197,160,89,0.3)]
buttons.qte_action: w-20 h-20 rounded-none bg-black/80 border-2 border-[#D92D20] text-[#D92D20] text-3xl flex items-center justify-center backdrop-blur-lg animate-pulse shadow-[4px_4px_0px_rgba(217,45,32,0.5)]

health_bar.boss: h-1 w-full bg-white/10 relative overflow-hidden mt-2
health_bar.boss_fill: absolute top-0 right-0 h-full bg-[#D92D20] transition-all duration-300

components.environmental_prompt: px-4 py-2 bg-[#12151C]/90 border border-white/10 text-white text-xs tracking-[0.2em] uppercase rounded-none backdrop-blur-md shadow-[4px_4px_0px_rgba(0,0,0,0.5)]

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Text elements brighten to #FFFFFF, borders glow with brand primary shadow.
motion_and_interactions.dialogue_entrance: Fade in and slide right (transform: translateX(-20px) to 0, opacity 0 to 1).
motion_and_interactions.qte_timing: Shrinking geometric frame around the button using framer-motion to indicate time limit.
motion_and_interactions.combat_hit: Brief screen shake (framer-motion x/y translation) and red flash overlay (opacity spike).

game_mechanics_ui.rendering_implementation: Use @react-three/fiber. Render the world (ravine, trees, mud) using 3D meshes. Render characters (player, Kairen, NPCs) as Billboard `<sprite>` or `<mesh>` with `<planeGeometry>` always facing the camera.
game_mechanics_ui.weather: Implement particle system for rain using @react-three/drei `<Sparkles>` or custom shaders. Darken scene lighting, add fog.
game_mechanics_ui.environmental_combat: When player is near an interactive object (rock/tree), show environmental_prompt. On key press, trigger QTE sequence for dodge/attack.

testing.requirements: All actionable buttons, dialog choices, and QTE inputs must have `data-testid` attributes (e.g., `data-testid="qte-dodge-button"`, `data-testid="dialogue-next-button"`).

image_urls.description: 2D pixel art sprite of an 8-year-old boy in rustic tunic. (Note: Image generation tools hit rate limits. Main agent to use local CSS art, colored meshes, or basic geometries as temporary stand-ins without using banned placeholder URLs).
2D pixel art of Kairen, human warrior with sword.
Muddy ravine, rain, ancient greek ruins background texture.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a 2.5D game using React Three Fiber. The UI overlay must sit on top of the `<Canvas>` using absolute positioning.
Use standard React UI state to manage dialogue, health, and QTE triggers over the 3D scene.
Implement character sprites as billboarding planes in the 3D scene. Ensure they face the camera.
Follow the jewel & luxury dark theme—everything must feel cinematic, moody, and dangerous. Avoid flat bright colors except for critical warnings (like the boss health bar or QTE prompts).
Ensure asymmetry in layout: place dialogues bottom-left, boss health top-right. Do not center-align everything.

Since external image APIs failed, DO NOT use services like via.placeholder.com. Use Three.js primitives (like colored cubes/spheres) to represent characters and trees until real assets are implemented, or generate local CSS shapes.
